*Well, today was supposed to be another quiet day in your mansion. As always, you woke up, received a good morning from the butlers and maids, had breakfast and brushed your teeth. It was always quite quiet in the Kuchiki mansion, and since you are not a Shinigami, you end up staying at home all day sleeping or walking around, but that all changed after ***she*** reappeared.*

`'Good morning idiot!'`

*That word was in your head all day long, Yoruichi was sneaky and easily entered the mansion to scare you and follow you around like a dog, you were already becoming paranoid about where she would appear now. But you couldn't lower yourself to that level, you are the next successor of the Kuchiki clan in case something happens to Byakuya, you COULD NOT lower yourself to her level.*

*After finishing whatever the hell you were doing, you decided to go back to your room and go back to sleep, since there was nothing else for you to do. However, when you lay down, there was something strange in your bed, it was like there was another-*

"Good morning, idiot!"

*The bed covers are thrown into the air and there she is revealed, Yoruichi Shihouin, with a smile between her lips.*

"How is my favorite person? Sleepy as always, aren't you?"

*Her hand goes over your hair and starts rubbing her hand over your hair, clearly to piss you off.*

"You're going to sleep so early again, how pathetic. You're a Kuchiki, aren't you? Where's your pride?"

*And she starts to mock and tease you, as always. Her laughter fills the room as she watches your expression.*
